blocking_findings.finding: C01 cannot receive implementation authority: the required non-forgeable issuer and capability lifecycle are unresolved. Current trust is entirely caller-controlled, so an in-process ActionSpec cannot prove an agent or remote caller is restricted.
blocking_findings.required_change: Add and accept a C01 authority decision in its governing child spec or ADR before production code: issuer and trust boundary, audience, expiry, renewal, revocation, replay protection, capability verification, audit, local-operator fallback, and the test-shell policy. Split C01 into evidence-only red reproducers followed by this decision, then implementation.

blocking_findings.finding: The plan requires an accepted child spec before a builder acts, but the C01 child spec is only proposed and absent. The STOP gate permits red tests without naming a governed test-only writer or excluding capability-contract assertions that cannot be specified before the authority decision.
blocking_findings.required_change: Create and accept a narrowly test-only F-22 C01 child-spec checkpoint. It must authorize only the listed reproducers, assign one writer and reviewer, prohibit production-source changes, and defer SEC-002's final capability assertion until the authority decision exists.

blocking_findings.finding: Release closure depends on a mutation method and threshold that do not exist, while the plan assigns their approval to a critic rather than a governing decision owner. A critic may review evidence but cannot invent the release threshold.
blocking_findings.required_change: Before C08, record the mutation method, threshold, exception policy, decision owner, and evidence artifact in approved governance. Keep C08 blocked until that decision and the defined Windows-runner decision are evidenced.

non_blocking_concerns.finding: Focused baselines are useful discovery evidence, not current-commit release proof. The plan correctly reserves full tests, release validation, security scans, benchmarks, dogfood, and final review for C08.

GitNexus is fresh and the specified impact command is executable, but its upstream result for resolveOperationContext is empty despite main resolving it. Source confirmation remains necessary as the plan already requires.

plan_strengths: All 29 canonical findings have exactly one primary owner in the completion matrix; local verification counted 29 unique mappings.
The plan correctly routes DB v2, Windows/WSL, adapter transaction integrity, and knowledge-store work to proposed F-25 through F-28 instead of silently closing them under F-22.
C01 accurately identifies the central authorization, protected-path, redaction, and rollback boundaries. The cited source anchors and focused test files exist.

The dependency DAG, one-writer policy, independent review, atomic commit/push to dev, revert policy, concurrency/fault-injection expectations, security gates, benchmark gates, dogfood, and reviewer-only closure are materially strong.

Repository-local commands are used appropriately for source-repository validation: package scripts provide kernel and release gates, while the plan reserves ./afol for repo-local development validation.
required_plan_changes: Insert a governed C01 test-only checkpoint before any test write, with one writer, one independent reviewer, exact test files, and no production-source scope.

Separate red reproducers that demonstrate present behavior from post-decision capability-contract tests. Red-test-only work may proceed for explicit restricted invocation and non-secret fixture cases; it must not claim that omitted markers or forged capabilities are distinguishable until the launcher decision exists.
Add the trusted-launcher/capability decision as a required C01 dependency before source implementation, not merely as a STOP discovered after an unspecified red-test phase.
Replace critic approval of mutation tooling/threshold with an approved governance decision and bind it, Windows-runner evidence, and all future-feature route decisions to C08 closure.
allowed_first_action: Governance-only: create and accept the F-22 C01 test-only child-spec checkpoint. It may then authorize one writer to add only R-02 plus SEC-001, SEC-003, SEC-004, and SEC-006 red reproducers using explicit --agent inputs and non-secret fixtures; no production source, launcher contract, capability assertion, manifest, or release change is allowed.
forbidden_until: Any C01 production implementation in operation-context, main, registry, router, file, adapter, or workbench code until the authority decision is accepted.
Any claim that direct invocation, omitted markers, or a forged capability is safely classified before the trusted launcher boundary is defined.
Enabling or exposing done --test-shell to agent-facing execution paths.
F-25, F-26, F-27, or F-28 implementation before their respective roadmap/spec and stated policy or runner gates are accepted.
C08 release, closure, versioning, main merge, deploy, or global-install smoke before all governed gates and final independent review pass.
